# Torque Blog & Portal

Torque is a modern, high-performance blogging and educational news portal optimized for speed, security, and developer productivity. It is built using Next.js (App Router) and Cloudflare Pages.

## Core Features
- **Educational News & Career Dashboard**: Homepage layout featuring Lead Spotlight updates, Category explore strips, IGNOU Study Desk, Sarkari Job Opportunity boards, and quick resource sidebars.
- **Dynamic Config Settings**: Settings engine backed by SQLite (D1) database, allowing administrators to live-configure marquee tickers, action checklists, sidebar links, and Telegram social cards.
- **File & Media Uploader**: Secure uploader (Cloudflare R2) supporting images, PDFs, Word documents (.doc, .docx), and ZIP archives up to 10MB for sharing syllabus files and resources.
- **Full-featured CMS**: Rich editor with full-featured dashboards to manage posts, tags, categories, media uploads, and comments.
- **Secure Authentication**: JWT-based session tokens stored in secure, HttpOnly cookies verified on the Cloudflare Edge.

## APIs for Agents & Clients
- `GET /api/posts`: List published posts. Optional query filters: `?category=slug`, `?tag=slug`, `?limit=N`.
- `GET /api/categories`: List all categories.
- `GET /api/tags`: List all tags.
- `GET /api/settings?key=homepage`: Fetch active homepage configurations (alerts, portals, checklist, telegram).
- `PUT /api/settings?key=homepage`: Update homepage configurations (requires Admin role authentication).
- `POST /api/upload`: Upload files to Cloudflare R2 (images, PDFs, DOC/DOCX, ZIP) up to 10MB.
